comment: Production dependencies with known advisories that this server does not execute. Anything NOT listed here fails the Security workflow. Review the reasons whenever the SDK is upgraded: an entry stops being true the moment src/ imports an HTTP transport.

allowed.hono: Reached only through @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's HTTP transport. src/index.js imports server/stdio.js and never server/streamableHttp.js, so this code is installed but never loaded.
allowed.@hono/node-server: Same path as hono: the SDK's HTTP transport, which this server does not use.
allowed.express-rate-limit: SDK HTTP transport dependency. No HTTP listener runs in a stdio server.
allowed.ip-address: Reached through express-rate-limit, itself part of the SDK's unused HTTP transport.
allowed.path-to-regexp: Reached through express, part of the SDK's unused HTTP transport.
allowed.body-parser: Reached through express, part of the SDK's unused HTTP transport.
allowed.qs: Reached through express, part of the SDK's unused HTTP transport.
